agent_observations.title: Cardiology summary
agent_observations.detail: HFrEF on 4-pillar GDMT, EF recovered 28→38%. AFib rate-controlled, anticoagulated (CHA₂DS₂-VASc 5). 2 optimization items flagged below.
agent_observations.why_rationale: Summary derived from echocardiogram trend, medication list, and risk score computation. EF improvement from nadir of 28% to current 38% represents partial recovery on GDMT.

agent_observations.detail: Paroxysmal AFib, presently sinus on last ECG
agent_observations.why_rationale: ECG 04/12/2026 shows sinus rhythm. Known paroxysmal AFib on problem list.

agent_observations.title: ARNI sub-target — uptitration opportunity
agent_observations.detail: Sacubitril/valsartan at 49/51 mg BID; target 97/103 mg BID. Current BP 126/75, K⁺ 4.6 mmol/L, eGFR 62 — all permit uptitration.
agent_observations.why_rationale: PARADIGM-HF target dose is 97/103 mg BID. Patient is currently at 49/51 mg BID (sub-target). Hemodynamic and metabolic parameters are within safe range for uptitration.

agent_observations.title: Aspirin + DOAC — consider discontinuing ASA
agent_observations.detail: Patient is on ASA 81 mg + apixaban, >12 months post-PCI (2019). Current evidence supports discontinuing ASA to reduce bleeding risk (HAS-BLED contributor).
agent_observations.why_rationale: AHA/ACC guidelines (2023) suggest that beyond 12 months post-PCI in patients on anticoagulation for AFib, dual antithrombotic therapy does not reduce ischemic events but increases bleeding. ASA discontinuation is recommended.
